news.title: Spectra Workshop: mods and resource packs
news.body: Spectra Launcher 1.0.0 brings the Workshop: resource packs, data mods and code mods for Prismfall and LUMEN, made by players and checked by Spectra staff before they go up. Open a game page and press Workshop to browse and subscribe, or read the mod guide to make your own.

news.title: LUMEN is out: Stormlight Salvage
news.body: Our second game is here. Fly a scrap-built ship through a storm-torn sky, shoot sky-pirates apart and bolt their parts onto your hull, then make it home before the storm tears it apart. Free in the Spectra Launcher.

news.title: Prismfall 1.4.5: 54 new achievements
news.body: Prismfall goes from 34 to 88 achievements: every boss beyond the Rift Titan, Boss Rush on Nightmare, all ten classes, half-hour survival runs, the story chronicles, online wins and four new secrets. Heads up, Achievement Specialists: these count towards your tag.

news.title: Prismfall 1.4.4 ALPHA: the true forms, rebuilt
news.body: The Unchained bosses in Prismfall · Test are rebuilt from the ground up: new bodies, new attacks, new second phases. The Hive Empress is a vast wasp sovereign, the Mirror Colossus reflects you back at yourself, and the Rift Titan’s eye is split by the Rift. Spawn any of them in the Concept Lab.

news.title: Prismfall 1.4.3 ALPHA: bigger chapters, and something unreleased
news.body: Every story chapter now runs four or five objectives across a bigger, more detailed map: escort the evacuation bus through Landfall, carry seed cores out of the Cold Vault, smash the Hive Empress’s printing vats, hunt a fleeing Prime Splinter. Data logs hide the rest of the story. And if you type a certain word on the main menu, the Chronicle I bosses come back unchained.

news.title: LUMEN is coming
news.body: A scrap-built ship, a storm-torn sky, and every pirate part yours to bolt on. Our next game is a salvage run through a sky archipelago in the observatory’s brass and ink. It is not out yet: press Notify me on its page and we will email you once, the day it releases.

news.title: Prismfall 1.4.2 ALPHA: a story you play through
news.body: Every story chapter now has its own place and its own objectives, from defending the colony relay to hacking the Hive Empress’s printer, with lore told as you play and bosses that come through gates. Three interludes fill the gap between Chronicle I and II, the Rainbow is the strongest and hardest secret class, and the Conduit and Scorcher have new abilities.

news.title: Prismfall 1.4 ALPHA: the story, boss themes and levels
news.body: Chronicles I and II now tell their story as you play and end with a glimpse of Chronicle III. Every boss gets its own breakcore theme, the Reaper gets four melee weapons, the Iron Sovereign takes up his arms, and you can build and share your own levels (beta). The shop also makes two new trails every week.

news.title: Prismfall 1.3.3: secret classes, the Iron Court and ready-up
news.body: The Blightcaller joins, the Railgunner turns secret alongside the Reaper and Rainbow, evolved classes arrive in alpha, the Iron Sovereign and Hive Empress are reworked, every boss brings its own hostiles, the Engineer gets five more builds, and multiplayer has ready-up.

news.title: Prismfall 1.3.2: boss cutscenes, fusions and overheat
news.body: Every boss now has an intro, a phase 2 and a death scene (key bosses get a phase 3). Elements beat elements, elemental bosses fuse when Ascended, the Engineer gets a build menu and four shop builds, sprays overheat, and there is a Random mode and a Procedural map.

news.title: Prismfall 1.3 (build 22): class reworks
news.body: A plague Railgunner, a shotgun-and-shield Vanguard, an Engineer who builds turrets, barricades, traps and repair stations, real lightning for the Conduit, flames for the Scorcher, black holes for the Gravitar, and a weapon on every ship.

news.title: Prismfall 1.3 (build 21): the elemental bosses reworked
news.body: All eight Chronicle II bosses have new designs and attacks: a segmented ice worm, a magma serpent, a king whose floating gauntlets grab you, and more. Story mode now unlocks classes chapter by chapter.

news.title: Prismfall 1.3: Story mode and the second breach
news.body: A Story mode alpha, Rift Breach II with eight elemental bosses, five new classes, a reworked Rift Titan and bosses, Creative building, and a rotating shop.

news.title: Prismfall 1.2: elements, a shop and the Codex
news.body: Burning, shocking and poisoning elements, new hostiles and bosses, evolved bosses on Insane and Nightmare, a Prism Shop, the Daily Rift, seeds and a much bigger Icon Creator.

news.title: Spectra is on Android
news.body: Get Spectra for Android from the download page: your library, friends and achievements on your phone, and Prismfall with touch controls.

news.title: Prismfall 1.0 is live
news.body: One hull. Endless light. Steer, aim and fire your way through the rift in Spectra Games' neon survival shooter.

games.title: Prismfall
games.tagline: One hull. Endless light. Survive the rift.
games.description: A neon arena survival shooter. Steer your hull, aim your prism cannon and fire by hand while you dash and harvest light shards to level up. Stay inside the red border of the rift, survive escalating swarms, and break the Prism Wraith when it breaches.
features: Hands-on tank controls: thrust, turn, aim and fire yourself
A big arena with a follow camera, and a deadly red border
30 escalating upgrades in five rarities, from Common to Legendary
Online multiplayer for up to 4: co-op waves with revives, or versus rounds. Invite friends from Spectra Launcher
Nine hostile types, from charging lancers to healers and phase-shifting phantoms, plus the Prism Wraith boss
88 achievements (nine of them secret) and an Icon Kit of unlockable hulls and colours
A live synthwave soundtrack (menu, chase and boss themes) and synth effects, all generated in real time

notes: New mode: Arcade. Prismfall as a bullet hell: twelve stages of Prism Emitters, shot curtains and bosses, with its own soundtrack. Your hitbox is the white core, and grazing shots scores
Waves and Endless Waves are now in single-player too: 30 waves with a boss every 5th and the Rift Titan on wave 30 (it counts towards Ascension)
Arcade bosses climb four tiers: Normal, Evolved, Ascended, then Malevolence. After each boss you heal and pick a free upgrade
Three Malevolences, each with its own body, spell cards, music, entrance and ending: Vesperine the Unlit, the Maw of Seven and Astraea Null. On Nightmare they are brutal
Two new classes: the Weaver (helix threads, Loom slows shots) and the Chronomancer (clock-hand bolts that stop and surge, Stopwatch freezes shots)
Evolved classes reworked (2,000 to 3,000 prisms): every class has its own stats, a specialised aura and a new ability on G
New: Ascended classes (7,500 to 10,000 prisms). Each has its own stats, an attack change, an aura with passives, a new look and an ultimate on T
Ascension needs the Rift Titan beaten on Nightmare in Story, Normal and Waves, then one more Nightmare Titan before each further Ascension. Hold up to three; deleting one gives back 20%
Seven new health upgrades: Nanoweave, Lifebloom, Vital Core, Blood Bank, Mending Pulse, Overgrowth and Phoenix Heart
Secret classes, and their upgrades, Evolved and Ascended items, stay hidden in the shop until you unlock them
Comet Tyrant nerfed: less hull and contact damage, slower charges with a longer wind-up, fewer shots and smaller fire hazards
Fixed: Procedural maps with two voids only drew one, so the zone timer could start with no void in sight
Achievements now belong to your Spectra account: each account on a PC has its own achievements and lifetime counts
Signed out, achievements belong to the PC. Unlocks from before this update go to the first account that opens the game
Spectra Workshop support: subscribe to mods and resource packs from the game page in Spectra Launcher
Resource packs recolour the neon, swap sounds and restyle the menus (achievements and online play stay on)
Data mods change upgrades, hostiles, bosses and difficulties; code mods run their own code with the game’s events
While a data or code mod is on, achievements and online play are off, and the menu shows MODDED
54 new achievements, from 34 to 88: one for every boss beyond the Rift Titan, Elemental Pantheon and Boss Hunter
Closing the rift: Boss Rush (and on Nightmare), Breach II, the Daily Rift, modifiers, Minimalist, five classes, all ten classes, a secret class and five maps
Long haul: survive 20 and 30 minutes, level 30, 1,000 kills or 100,000 score in a run, 10,000 and 50,000 kills in total, 25 and 100 runs
Story, online and shop: chapters, both chronicles, the interludes, online matches, Versus wins, prisms earned, shop purchases, evolved and secret classes, Levels mode
Four new secret achievements to find
Fixed: the difficulty clears (Rift Tourist to Nightmare’s End) no longer unlock for finishing a story chapter or a level, only for defeating the Rift Titan
ALPHA (Prismfall · Test): the six Unchained true forms are rebuilt as bosses of their own, each with a new body, its own movement, four original attacks and a second phase

The Hollow Light, Empress of the Endless Brood (a vast wasp sovereign), the Starfall, the Spiral of All Paths, the Hall of Glass (a mirror monolith that reflects you) and the Architect's Hand (its eye split by the Rift)
Concept Lab: spawn any of the six true forms from the Creative menu
ALPHA: story chapters now have 4-5 objectives each, tied to their story, with four new kinds: escort a convoy, carry cargo, destroy targets, and hunt an elite that runs
Bigger story maps with room to explore, and beacons you can light in any order
Hidden data logs in every chapter and interlude: pieces of the story, 25 prisms each, kept in the Codex
Detailed scenery for every chapter: station wrecks, hive pods, colony domes, the vault door, warship hulks and more
Prismfall · Test: type 'unreleased' on the main menu for a True Form Rush (the Chronicle I bosses Unchained) and a Concept Lab

The Library of Light (the Spiral Oracle's chapter) is now a real library: radial bookcases with ladders, reading tables and lamps, marble columns, globes, a carpet and glyph ring round the Halo well, chandeliers, window light and floating tomes

ALPHA: story chapters are now runs of objectives with their own lines of lore: defend a point, hack a terminal, light beacons, recover shards, close rift breaches, and staged boss entrances through gates
Every chapter has its own scenery: the colony city at night, crystal plains, the hive, a magma mine, a warship graveyard, the dying void city and more, with lights and weather
Three interludes between Chronicle I and II: Quiet Orbit, The Shard Speaks, Signal from the Deep
Codex elements stay hidden until you've met them
Rainbow buffed, with three attack styles (Q), prism bursts, and a 7s Spectrum with bigger beams and a longer sound; now the hardest secret to unlock
Smoother Prism Lance; new Conduit (Storm Conduit) and Scorcher (Solar Flare) abilities; plague cloud visuals for the Blightcaller
Engineer build hotkeys are letters only; 17 new shop upgrades, including one for every class
ALPHA patch: Reaper swings go side to side only (no more overhead chop or uppercut)
Twin Fangs is replaced by the Morning Star: a spiked ball whirled all the way around you
New Reaper ability, Phantom Cut: blink through up to 6 nearby hostiles for 4x melee damage each, executing weak ones
Music is back to the original synthwave soundtrack (the per-boss breakcore themes are removed)
ALPHA patch: Reaper melee hits harder and reaches further
Two new melee weapons: Twin Fangs (double-striking daggers) and the Halberd (a long thrust)
All six melee weapons have new models, and swings alternate left, right, overhead and uppercut, with windups, light smears, afterimages and hit sparks
New class upgrades for every class, secret classes included (Executioner's Edge, Blood Harvest, Echo Swing, Full Spectrum, Capacitor Bank and more)
The Iron Sovereign grips his greatsword, hammer, crossbow and shield in both gauntlets and carries them through each attack
ALPHA: Chronicles I and II are longer and tell their story as you play (Relay Command, the shard and the Null Empress speak), with a colour for every chapter
The end of Chronicle II: a void closes in and memories of Chronicle III flicker past
Every boss has its own original breakcore / glitchcore theme
Reaper: four melee weapons (scythe, greatsword, great-hammer, shield), switched with Q
Rainbow: Spectrum fires seven piercing beams that merge into one (5s, 20s cooldown)

Iron Sovereign rework: knightly gauntlets, a two-handed greatsword slash, crossbow, hammer and shield, a horn that calls ten of his court, and Coglings that repair him; Ferrite Knights and Crossbowmen reworked
Hive Empress faces forward; the Blightcaller has a new look
Levels (beta): build a level in Creative, share its code, play it from the Levels mode
Shop: two brand-new trails every week
Fair play: signed prism balances and reward caps; Tab for stats (no longer in the pause menu)
The Blightcaller (plague spores) replaces the Railgunner, which becomes a secret class; more secret classes: the Reaper (with its Prism Reaper form) and Rainbow, the rarest
Evolved classes (alpha) in a new shop tab
Overheat now counts every shot (no spam-clicking around it) and includes the Lancer, whose beam is smooth and scales with fire rate; the Conduit hits harder

Engineer: builds last up to 90s but hostiles break them; five more shop builds (Coolant Station, Flak Cannon, Cryo Projector, Shard Beacon, Overclock Relay); Twin Turrets doubles pylons and mortars; Z X C V B N M hotkeys
Iron Sovereign rework (plated arms, greatsword, crossbows, a war horn that calls his court) and the Hive Empress (honour guard and larvae)

Tempest Eye spins faster as it breaks; the Oracle's phase 3 feeds on your shots; the Null Empress weakens everyone, then implodes; fire and ice worms mirror each other; fusions only on Nightmare or as a rare mutation
Every boss has its own 1-3 hostiles (Plaguelites, Coglings, Frostlings and more)
Story: Chronicle II reordered; at the end of a chronicle, end the run or carry your build on; online, only chapters everyone has reached
Multiplayer ready-up: the host can start once everyone is ready
Pause menu with a run summary and restart; new settings (cutscenes, reduced flashing, fewer particles, combat text)
Overheat: the Scorcher and Conduit fire for 5 seconds, then weaker shots; let go and they lock for 3.5s while they cool
Engineer: each blueprint has its own cooldown; R opens a build menu with stats, limits and cooldowns; four more builds in the shop (Tesla Pylon, Shield Dome, Decoy Beacon, Mortar Nest)
Random mode and Random map, plus a new Procedural map
Stat menu: teammates' stats, active buffs with timers, and what your upgrades added
Elements beat elements (WEAK! / RESIST); elemental bosses get a true form (Evolved) and fuse with a second boss (Ascended)
Every boss: an intro cutscene, a phase 2 and a death scene; the last three bosses of each chronicle get a phase 3
Story: the Storm Seraph and Magma Leviathan belong to Chronicle II, and the Glaive and Railgunner unlock in Chronicle II
Story lore: the Null Empress's black hole now leads into Chronicle III, the Stasis
Railgunner: plague rails that poison everything they pierce and leave toxic trails; poisoned hostiles spread it when they die (Pandemic replaces Piercer)
Vanguard: a pump shotgun that hits hardest up close, a refilling Guard, and Shield Charge
Engineer: a builder with tagging rivets; E builds turrets, barricades, shock traps or a repair station (R switches)
Conduit: real lightning strikes that chain; Scorcher: billowing flames; Gravitar: black holes
Glaive's metal chakrams, explosions for Artillery shells, and a weapon on every ship (an assault rifle for the Striker)
The Scorcher sprays large fire-coloured hexagons (same damage as before the rework)
Railgunner rails stay on screen for as long as their plague trail, fading out steadily
A recorded flamethrower sound for the Scorcher (fades out when you stop firing), and louder plague boiling
New recorded sounds for the Lancer's beam and Prism Lance, explosions and the Railgunner's boiling plague trails; the Scorcher's hexagons glow
The elemental bosses reworked, each with its own design, movement, attack patterns, shot looks and sounds
Glacial Wyrm: a 16-part ice worm that coils, burrows and bursts out beneath you
Magma Leviathan: a serpent that swims in magma pools and leaps out where you were
Iron Sovereign: gauntlets on magnetic joints that punch, slam, clap and grab (dash to break free)
Storm Seraph rods and arcs, Blight Mother pods and lashes, the Tempest Eye's turning weather fronts, the Tectonic Behemoth's plates and stone pillars, and a new look for the Null Empress
Story: each chronicle has its own hostiles, level and upgrade limits; you start with the Striker and unlock classes chapter by chapter (Story only)
Boss lists, the Chronicle and the chapter pickers are split under chronicle headers
Fixed: the stat menu stayed on screen after leaving a run
Story mode (alpha): 17 chapters across both rift breaches with briefings, objectives and endings, solo or online with up to 10 players
Rift Breach II: eight elemental bosses (one per element), unlocked by beating Breach I on Insane
Two new elements, Wind and Void, with new hostiles and upgrades
Five new classes: Glaive, Conduit, Scorcher, Gravitar and Railgunner, each with its own shot and ability
The Rift Titan reworked: a new model, floating boss fragments, every class's weapon, minor breaches (Evolved) and boss remakes you can stop (Ascended)
The final boss is Evolved on Hard and Ascended on Insane
Prism Wraith, Hive Queen, Comet Tyrant, Spiral Oracle and Mirror Colossus reworked with original Evolved/Ascended moves, phases and new designs
Snipers now fire an instant hitscan rail after showing their line
Creative: boss tier and level, building obstacles, layout codes and hostile infighting
Shop: weekly exclusives, daily deals, kill effects and more trails and accessories
Stats menu on Tab (and on the pause menu)
Play now covers solo and online, with smaller menu buttons
More lore: Breach II chapters and a story Chronicle in the Codex
Lancer: with Seeker Lens the beam now bends toward hostiles instead of staying straight
Faster game: hostiles and shots use a collision grid, and the HUD only updates what changed
Elements: hits can leave hostiles (and you) Burning, Chilled, Shocked, Muddy, Rusted or Poisoned, shown on the ship
15 elemental upgrades (fire, frost, lightning, earth, metal, poison) and 8 basic upgrades for any class
5 elemental hostiles: Pyre, Volt Coil, Mud Golem, Ferrite Knight and Spore Pod
2 new bosses after the Rift Titan: the Storm Seraph and the Magma Leviathan
Insane: every boss learns an extra move; Nightmare: two, plus elite hostiles with an extra trait
Boss Rush reworked: more bosses, boss duos, and faster, tougher, smarter bosses on each difficulty
Prism Shop (also in the multiplayer lobby): trails, accessories, extra upgrades, evolutions, Creative tools and icon slots
Prisms from every run and match: kills and time survived now pay too
Codex: the story of the Rift, every hostile and boss you've met, and the elements
Daily Rift: an arcade run of the day with the same seeded map and modifiers for everyone
Seeds: type or replay a seed for the same obstacles, a new seeded Shattered map, and seeds for multiplayer rooms
Icon Creator: no part limit, 28 shapes, 10 presets, and colour, opacity, outline, glow, fill, detail and stretch for every part
Prism Echo drones now fly outside your whole hull
Game modes: Normal (beat the Rift Titan to win), Endless, Boss Rush and Creative; in co-op also Waves (30 waves) and Endless Waves
Versus teams (2v2, 3v3, 4v4) and a new Infection mode
7 maps with differently shaped voids, and optional obstacles you can't see past (Ricochet bolts bounce off them)
Optional modifiers (Fog, Glass Cannon, Swarm, Ironclad, Haste, Bullet Hell, Famine, Brittle) that raise your reward
Prisms: a currency earned by beating the rift, more on harder difficulties and with modifiers (nothing to spend them on yet)
Creative mode (beat every boss on Hard) and an Icon Creator for your own hull (beat every boss on Medium)
Arrows to off-screen teammates and bosses, switch who you spectate while down, and 5 seconds to get back from the void
5 new achievements, one for beating the Rift Titan on each difficulty, plus trophy tiers in Spectra Launcher
Wardens nerfed a lot: half the hull, a weaker and narrower shield, and they turn slowly
Creative menu fixed (its buttons didn't respond to clicks) and it no longer pauses the game
Creative in co-op: everyone gets the menu, as long as everyone in the room has Creative unlocked
Classes: Striker (bolts), Lancer (laser beam), Artillery (exploding shells), Engineer (seeker darts) and Vanguard (scattergun), each with its own stats
Your class's upgrades come up 3× as often; off-class upgrades stop at 2–3 picks
Creative menu: search, sort and filter upgrades, hover to see the card, and switch level-up upgrades off
Hulls and colours are now bought with prisms in the Icon Kit (anything you'd already unlocked stays yours)
Lancer beams fixed: each Split beam now stops on its own target instead of all of them being cut short
Lancer: Piercing Light lets the beam pass through walls, Ricochet makes it bounce off walls; you can't have both
Class abilities on E: Overdrive, Prism Lance, Bombard, Turret and Bulwark, with a cooldown bar (and a touch button)
Class-only upgrades: 11 new cards, two or three for each class
More obstacles: L-walls, cross barricades, pillars, crystal clusters and breakable crates that drop shards
Initial release
Manual tank controls with a follow camera and a deadly red arena border
Nine hostile types plus the Prism Wraith boss
30 escalating upgrades in five rarities, picked from a hand of cards
29 achievements, a main menu, Icon Kit and settings
A live synthwave soundtrack that switches between menu, chase and boss themes
Online multiplayer (up to 10 players): co-op waves and versus rounds, with room codes and launcher invites
Plays on Android in Spectra for Android, with twin-stick touch controls
Fullscreen by default
Multiplayer: levels are per player, and each level-up brings upgrade cards straight away, even mid-wave
Multiplayer: exactly one upgrade per level-up, however fast you click
Co-op: choose Waves or Endless (single-player style, downed players back after 20s)
Multiplayer runs far smoother when everyone is firing: bolts, ships and glows are pre-rendered, off-screen objects are skipped, and network updates are about half the size
Settings redesigned: Audio and Display groups, neon volume sliders with live values, a new Effects volume slider and a reset-to-defaults button
FPS counter under BEST (can be turned off in Settings)
Pause menu redesigned: Resume and Main Menu beside the full Audio and Display options (volume sliders, fullscreen, screen shake, FPS counter)
15 new hostiles that join after each boss (1 after the first, 2 after the second... until all are in)
5 new bosses after the Prism Wraith: Hive Queen, Comet Tyrant, Spiral Oracle, Mirror Colossus and Rift Titan
Shards are the colour of the player who made the kill and only they can collect them; bosses drop a share for everyone
23 new upgrades, and the epics reworked: Satellites hit for full bolt damage with knockback, Nova Pulse is much stronger and wipes out hostile shots
Second Dawn in co-op: fly over a downed teammate to bring them back
New Secret rarity with its own odds: Event Horizon (1 in 10,000) and Annihilator (1 in 100,000)
14 new achievements: one for each new boss, Pantheon, Rift Warden, Blitz and Flawless, plus five for Secret upgrades
Upgrade cards are much easier to read, and the multiplayer card tray keeps full-size text
PC: your cannon aims at the mouse (crosshair and a barrel on your ship), separate from the way you fly
Phones: twin thumbsticks, left to move and right to aim and fire
Five difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard, Insane and Nightmare (harder runs score more)
Multiplayer for up to 10 players, and everyone always flies a different colour
Invite friends straight from the lobby: they get a popup in Spectra Launcher or Prismfall
7 new hull shapes and 10 new colours in the Icon Kit
New upgrade cards stay locked for a moment so a stray click can't pick one

games.title: LUMEN
games.tagline: Scrap-built hull. Storm-torn sky. Bring the light home.
games.description: A scrap-ship salvage run through a storm-torn sky archipelago. Shoot sky-pirates apart and bolt their parts onto your hull wherever they touch. Dive into squalls and thunderheads to harvest stormlight cores, then make it back to a floating dock before the strain tears your ship apart.
features: Build your ship mid-flight: every part bolts on wherever it touches your hull
Ten part types, from deck cannons and Lens Lances to lightning rods and ballast keels
Squalls that shear you sideways, thunderheads full of lightning, and the eye of the storm
Sky-pirates, gull drone swarms and a leviathan that hunts the deepest storms
Bank cores for Workshop upgrades, fly the shared Daily Voyage, and earn 63 Spectra achievements

notes: Achievements and your save (cores, Workshop upgrades, stats) are now kept per Spectra account
Signed out, they belong to the PC. A save from before this update goes to the first account that opens LUMEN
Spectra Workshop support: subscribe to mods and resource packs from the game page in Spectra Launcher
Resource packs recolour your ship and the menus; data mods change part stats; code mods run their own code with the voyage’s events
While a data or code mod is on, achievements are off and the title screen says MODDED
Real ship physics: your hull now has a centre of mass and turns about it
Thrusters push from where they sit. One off to the side of your centre of mass swings the nose the other way, so a thruster on the far left turns you right
Too much twist overpowers the Lens Core gyro and the ship spins out. Ballast Keels steady the gyro
Lopsided thrust no longer slides you sideways; heavy parts move the centre of mass, and off-centre knocks on islands set you spinning
New trim readout on the HUD (Trim true, Pulls, Spins, SPIN-OUT), and the centre of mass shows while you drag a part
First public release of LUMEN: Stormlight Salvage
Bolt salvaged pirate parts onto your hull wherever they touch, and drag them around to rebuild mid-flight
Placement matters: guns need a clear line of fire, and lopsided thrusters drift you sideways
Squalls, thunderheads, the eye of the storm, sky-pirates that scavenge, gull drones and the leviathan
Prismfall-style controls: W/S thrust, A/D turn, mouse to aim, Shift to dash
Workshop upgrades, a shared Daily Voyage and 63 achievements, including 11 in the Secret tier
